description: Hand-authored ground truth for one concrete code change: renaming greet -> greet_person in src/greeter.py. Every file listed in impacted_files genuinely imports/calls greet (verified by reading the fixture source, not inferred). non_impacted_files never reference greet at all and exist to catch false positives (precision noise).

impacted_files_rationale.src/caller_a.py: imports greet directly (`from src.greeter import greet`) and calls it
impacted_files_rationale.src/caller_b.py: imports the greeter module and calls greeter.greet(...)
impacted_files_rationale.tests/test_greeter.py: calls greet(...) directly in an assertion
impacted_files_rationale.tests/test_caller_a.py: exercises caller_a.announce, which calls greet transitively -- a real, indirect impact

non_impacted_files_rationale.src/unrelated.py: does not import or reference greeter/greet anywhere
